description: Permanently delete one saved version (bookmark or auto-snapshot). Accepts the version's UUID `id` or the `v<N>` shorthand. The bookmark v<N> sequence keeps gaps — numbers never re-shuffle — so any external snippet referencing the deleted `v<N>` will fail to resolve afterwards. Idempotent: deleting a non-existent version is a no-op.
